overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: vPosition
params.description: For list-type objects (subform, list form, hierarchical list, scrollable area, list box), the number of the first line displayed; for a picture (variable or field), the vertical scroll movement in pixels relative to the picture's origin. 0 for other object types.

params.name: hPosition
params.description: List box only: the number of the first fully-visible column; for a picture, the horizontal scroll movement in pixels relative to the picture's origin. 0 for other object types.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET SCROLL POSITION returns, in the vPosition and hPosition parameters, information related to the position of the scroll bars of the form object designated by the * and object parameters.

constraints: For subform-type objects, only the '*' (object-name) syntax is supported; the Variable/Field syntax cannot be used to designate a subform.
